safety.mergeAuthority: The existing Product quality gate remains the only merge authority during phase 1.

notes: Phase 1 is measurement-only and additive: the existing Full Product quality gate still runs unchanged on every pull request.
The selected Infrastructure tests use unique temp/in-memory SQLite, except MigrationRegistrationTests which builds the Npgsql model against an invalid host without opening a connection.

SharedHostIsolationTests uses one disposable SharedApiHost/SQLite database with unique logical data and fresh clients to cover hosted startup, authentication/session isolation, persistence, and project authorization.

Browser smoke is intentionally not in v1 because the current hosted Windows smoke path alone can consume most of the four-minute budget; it remains fully covered by the unchanged Full gate while Fast timing is established.
